title: High walls
idea: Earth magic on a grand scale: the ground can rise six steps, only five or more makes a wall, Wall of Stone rises five and Move Earth throws up a real hill.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.blurb: A towering 30 ft wall of rock rises from where you click, running away from you.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.blurb: The ground heaves up into a tall hill 35 ft across, highest in the middle.
